episodes.title: Storm Warning
episodes.summary: Gabriel accepts a mission to withdraw two Syrian hackers. Alison and Banks face escalating cyberattacks in London.

episodes.title: Chaos
episodes.summary: Believing he knows what will stop the attacks, Gabriel meets with Alison. A fateful event transpires in London.

episodes.title: Manipulations
episodes.summary: Gabriel tracks down Myriam, but he's not the only one on the Syrians' trail. Alison heads to Brussels to secure an EU cyber agreement.

episodes.title: Carnage
episodes.summary: Pressure mounts for Banks as another attack unfolds. Alison and Gabriel seek safety.

episodes.title: Family Album
episodes.summary: Dumas gives information to Sophie Saint-Roch. Alison and Gabriel head to London with Samir. A devastating secret is revealed.

episodes.title: An Eye for an Eye
episodes.summary: Series finale. Alison and Gabriel face new danger as everything converges at Antropa's London headquarters.
